displayPattern: Outdoor control display reads 02 or L2 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: High side fault: four consecutive compressor protector trips with average run time between trips of more than 1 minute and less than 15 minutes, with the low and high pressure switches closed.
causes: Dirty condenser coil or failed outdoor fan motor
diySteps: Technician: check the resistance of the high pressure switch and cycle power if it is open; replace the switch if pressure is not high
Technician: if pressure is high, check and clean the condenser coil, check the outdoor fan motor, the capacitor and the wiring, and repair or replace as needed
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: the repeated compressor protector trips can damage the compressor.
